description: This is a C source file implementing various utility functions for a file differential library, including functions for mathematical calculations, file handling, diff formatting, and hashing mechanisms.

methods.name: long xdl_bogosqrt(long n)
methods.description: Performs an integer square root approximation using shifts.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diffrec(char const * rec,long size,char const * pre,long psize,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emits a diff record, formatting the differences between two file contents.

methods.name: void * xdl_mmfile_first(mmfile_t * mmf,long * size)
methods.description: Returns the pointer to the first byte of a memory-mapped file or buffer.

methods.name: long xdl_mmfile_size(mmfile_t * mmf)
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory-mapped file or buffer.

methods.name: int xdl_cha_init(chastore_t * cha,long isize,long icount)
methods.description: Initializes a chastore_t structure for buffering data.

methods.name: void xdl_cha_free(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Frees all nodes in a chastore_t linked list.

methods.name: void * xdl_cha_alloc(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Allocates a node in the chastore_t structure.

methods.name: long xdl_guess_lines(mmfile_t * mf,long sample)
methods.description: Guesses the number of lines in a memory-mapped file based on a sample size.

methods.name: int xdl_blankline(const char * line,long size,long flags)
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank or whitespace-only, considering flags.

methods.name: int ends_with_optional_cr(const char * l,long s,long i)
methods.description: Checks if a line ends with an optional carriage return before newline.

methods.name: int xdl_recmatch(const char * l1,long s1,const char * l2,long s2,long flags)
methods.description: Compares two lines with optional whitespace and CR ignoring flags.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top,uint64_t flags)
methods.description: Computes a hash of a record, considering whitespace handling flags.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_verbatim(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top)
methods.description: Computes a straightforward hash of a record, with special handling for two-character blocks.

methods.name: unsigned int xdl_hashbits(unsigned int size)
methods.description: Calculates the number of bits needed for a hash table size.

methods.name: int xdl_num_out(char * out,long val)
methods.description: Converts a long integer to a string representation.

methods.name: int xdl_format_hunk_hdr(long s1,long c1,long s2,long c2,const char * func,long funclen,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Formats a hunk header line for diff output.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_hunk_hdr(long s1,long c1,long s2,long c2,const char * func,long funclen,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emits a diff hunk header, possibly delegating to formatting function.

methods.name: int xdl_fall_back_diff(xdfenv_t * diff_env,xpparam_t const * xpp,int line1,int count1,int line2,int count2)
methods.description: Performs a fallback diff operation on file ranges.
